143 : 170 

= 12² - 1 : (12 + 1)² +1

483 : 530

= 22² - 1 : (22 + 1)² + 1

Similarly,

255 = 16² - 1

(16 + 1)² + 1= 17² + 1 = 289 + 1 = 290

The Required value is** 290.**

**Hence, the correct answer is "option (4)".**

questions.question:
In this question, a statement is given followed by two courses of action numbered I and II. You have to take the statements to be true even if it seems to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which of the given sequence of action is to be taken logically.

Statement: Farmers are unable to sell their products due to low demand.

Course of action:

I: The government should buy products from farmers at a price below the cost price and export them at a higher price.

II: Government should not interfere in this situation as it will cause trouble to the farmers.
questions.solution:
Statement: Farmers are unable to sell their produce due to low demand.

As statement says Farmers are unable to sell their products due to low demand.

**Course of action:**

I: The government should buy products from farmers at a price below the cost price and export them at a higher price.

If the government buys their product below the cost price this will not help them to recover their loss, hence this is **not** the right statement to help the farmers.

**Hence, the course of action I do not follows.**

II: Government should not interfere in this situation as it will cause trouble to the farmers.

Government should interfere in this situation otherwise how farmers sell their product on a large scale. Hence, this is also** not** the right statement to help farmers.

**Hence, the course of action II do not follows.**

Hence, **Option (1)** is correct.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Some rules to solve Statements and Course of action questions must be kept in mind while solving it.

Rule 1. Have an unbiased and neutral mind frame. Individual perception must not be used to judge the course of action to be taken.

Rule 2. The first step should be to identify the root cause of the problem. Once the problem is solved, a logical mindset should be employed to figure out the course of action.

Rule 3. There must be no extremity involved in the course of action.

Rule 4. A course of action must be able to solve, reduce, or minimize the problem given in the situation.

Rule 5. The course of action can be said to solve/reduce the problem when it is an established fact, when it is logically possible and when it is known from experience.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follows from the statements.

**Statements:**

All camels are fractals.

No fractal is a tube.

All pianos are camels.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some tubes are camels.

II. No piano is a tube.

options.text: Either conclusion I or II follows
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd54e59cc9abd6d7e48b146fd3a0dd252197e0780eab0630ca2c30b6e961fa8f.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some tubes are camels. → Does not follow (As, All camels are fractals and No fractal is a tube, which means no camel is tube)

II. No piano is a tube. → **Follows** (As, All pianos are camel, All camels are fractals and No fractal is a tube, which means no piano is a tube)

Hence, '**Only conclusion II follows**' is the correct answer.

Directions: A statement is followed by two inferences I and II. You have to consider the statement to be true even if it seems to be at variance from the commonly known facts. You have to decide which of the given inferences, if any, follow from the statement.

**Statement**: The Government of India is planning to open up COVID-19 vaccination for all above 18 years of age from 1st May 2021.

I. The Government is taking necessary steps to stop the spread of COVID-19 in India.

II. People between the age of 18 - 45 are the main reason for the spread of COVID-19.
questions.solution:
The statement claims that the Government of India is planning to vaccinate people above 18 years of age to fight against COVID-19, This means Government is taking necessary steps to stop the spread of COVID-19 in India. Therefore, **Inference I follows**.

The statement does not mention that people between the age of 18 - 45 are the main reason for the spread of COVID-19. Therefore **Inference II does not follow**.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Only Inference I follows".**

questions.question: In a certain code language, ‘FLY’ is written as ‘38’ and ‘NUT’ is written as ‘26’. How will ‘GOD’ be written in that language?

Logic: **Sum of the opposite letter's place value of the alphabets = Code.**

'FLY' is written as '38'

→ 21 + 15 + 2 = 38.

'NUT' is written as '26'

→ 13 + 6 + 7 = 26.

Similarly, for **'GOD'**

**→ 20 + 12 + 23 = 55.**

So, 'GOD' will be written as '55'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**

questions.question: A, B, C, D, E and F live on six different floors of the same building. questions.question:
In the questions below, is given a statement followed by two assumptions numbered I and II. An assumption is something supposed or taken for granted. You have to consider the statement and the assumptions and decide which of the assumption(s) is/are implicit in the statement.

Statement: Please do not lean out of the running bus, a notice in a tourist bus.

Assumptions: 

I. Leaning out of running bus is dangerous.

II. The passengers are likely to pay attention to this notice.

options.text: If only Assumption I is implicit
If only Assumption II is implicit
If neither I nor II is implicit
If both I and II are implicit

questions.solution:
The logic followed is:

'Do not lean out' implies that this act can be dangerous.

Hence, Assumption I is implicit.

The purpose of a notice is to get a response from the targeted mass. Therefore, without assuming a positive response from the targeted mass, there will be no such notice.

So, Assumption II is implicit.

Hence, the correct answer is** "If both I and II are implicit".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**

 
• Read the statement with an approach that the assumptions would be true with regard to the statement.
 
• Do not go too logical with the statements. Analyze the given information and the assumption must only be made based on the information in the statement. Do not over-complicate it.
 
• Common assumptions can always be followed but other than that do not align the statement with General Knowledge or other facts
 
• Use the elimination method if you are unable to apprehend the answer. Read the statement and then the assumptions given in the options, you shall notice that a few of them will most definitely not follow. Eliminate them and then choosing from lesser options may prove to be more convenient
 
• One thing to make a note of is that the assumption is something that the author believes to be true so while choosing the correct option, keep this thought in mind as well. If any option contradicts the statement, then that assumption will not follow.
